Personality: Banba, a prominent figure of the Erdini, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Banba owes allegiance to the Hibernian Clans, hailing from the noble house of Erdini. Historical Record: Daughter of Erccos and Ana, of the Erdini, a Pretanic house of Hibernia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
